summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity that embeds kangaroo care for low birth weight babies in existing hospitals, modelled for four hospitals in Pakistan. The idea Ansh was founded to run (Ansh went on to work in India). A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: the cost per DALY averted of the four-hospital program (about $98).
